spring: application: name: ApiGateway cloud: gateway: routes: # CommonService Routes - id: common-service-users uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/users/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-posts uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/posts/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-groups uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/groups/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-events uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/events/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-friends uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/friends/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-notifications uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/notifications/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: common-service-all uri: http://localhost:8081 predicates: - Path=/api/common/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
# MessegeService Routes - id: message-service-conversations uri: http://localhost:8082 predicates: - Path=/api/message/conversations/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: message-service-messages uri: http://localhost:8082 predicates: - Path=/api/message/messages/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: message-service-calls uri: http://localhost:8082 predicates: - Path=/api/message/calls/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
- id: message-service-all uri: http://localhost:8082 predicates: - Path=/api/message/** filters: - StripPrefix=2
# Global CORS Configuration globalcors: cors-configurations: '[/**]': allowedOrigins: "*" allowedMethods: - GET - POST - PUT - DELETE - PATCH - OPTIONS allowedHeaders: "*" allowCredentials: true maxAge: 3600
server: port: 8080
# Actuator endpoints management: endpoints: web: exposure: include: health,info,gateway endpoint: health: show-details: always
# Logging logging: level: org.springframework.cloud.gateway: DEBUG org.springframework.web: INFO
